data.name: Barika
data.gender_notes: Barika is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Barika means 'blessing' or 'fortune'. It is a name with rich spiritual significance in Islamic culture. The name is derived from the Arabic word 'barakah' which refers to divine blessings and protection. In the Quran, Allah (swt) is described as the Bestower of Blessings and the Giver of Wisdom. The name Barika carries the meaning “Blessing, Fortune” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Barika usually hope their child will grow to embody blessing, fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Barika belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessing, Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Barika total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
